# R448 — Primary inference adoption audit

Date: 2026-10-14 (Asia/Tokyo)
Mode: read-only source/report audit. Sole new artifact: this report. No source, Git, environment, build, test, fetch, measurement, process, or GPU changes/actions. The known old GPU-failure version of primary was not run. No private JSON or raw logs were opened.

## Pinned scope

- Personal primary: `/home/yayoi/orca/workspaces/Strata/sycl`, `feature/sycl` HEAD `4fa478f50f8da396e651e3ae862f8b1849d49b54`; target is Arc B570 + Ryzen 5 5600X + 128 GB RAM.
- Fork `main`: `beddab2fd6b61631d73b39b7484bc9a585ebe1de`. This audit uses it only as a source-difference reference; no changes to either branch.
- Sole upstream remains Niko1221/Strata. This round makes no new upstream revision comparison. CUDA/HIP paths are outside the target.
- Xe-derived Z: worktree `.worktree/feat-layer-major-bulk-upload-20261013`, HEAD `28a7b9ae7ca5eba28eecd65f6453a7479c04fce8`; tested/source identity cited by R443 and the candidate report is `85cb6b1968bd5c2156eed3b10dbb332f92ee95ac`.
- Xe-derived W phase4k: `.worktree/feat-layer-major-phase4k-20261013`, HEAD `9c83ea6ba02a562d55cd90ae678aadebc2b88ae2`.
- Working tree initially had pre-existing `AGENTS.md` modification and untracked `.agents/`, `.claude/`; they were not touched.

## Primary path and optimizations to retain

Primary's active request path is `src/program/generate.cpp` into `src/prefill/prefill.cpp` for chunked prompt work and `src/core/layer.cpp` plus `src/kernels/sycl/*` for the SYCL routes. The current prefill source has no `run_layer_major` implementation/selector. It contains a streamed expert ring, MMQ/native/fused selection and staging/cache logic. The one-token decode path and multi-token verify/MTP paths have separate callers/row geometry; no prefill result qualifies decode. Relevant implementation inventory:

| Area | Primary source entrypoints | Existing optimization/contract to preserve | Evidence boundary |
|---|---|---|---|
| Prompt scheduling and expert residency | `src/program/generate.cpp`; `src/prefill/prefill.cpp`; `include/strata/core/expert_cache.hpp`; `src/core/expert_cache.cpp`; `src/core/expert_source.cpp` | Chunk selection/auto limits; expert-cache lending and per-layer behavior; streamed ring with pinned-share-dependent slots; staging and overlap; native-source/copy lifetimes; source/layout validation | Source comments preserve historical measurements for other GPUs/models; they are not B570 qualification. Current primary bench/results exist, but no opened receipt establishes a matched Z-vs-primary A/B. |
| Prompt MoE math | `src/prefill/moe_mmq.cpp`, `moe_fused.cpp`, `moe_fused_iq.cpp`; `src/kernels/sycl/native_iq_esimd.cpp`, `native_mmq_xmx.cpp`, `s2_experts.cpp`, `expert_routing.cpp` | Per-type MMQ/native IQ kernels, grouped routing, XMX/ESIMD dispatch and fallbacks; retain the selected dispatch and fallback eligibility, not just kernel bodies | IQ3_S GU prefill cannot be inferred from a generic MoE/MMQ result. Need exact selected B570 path, IQ3_S tensor/layout, chunk/T/rows, precision and comparator. No audited matched evidence supports replacing it. |
| CPU expert decode/service | `src/kernels/cpu/native_expert.cpp`, `iq_single_avx2.cpp`, `include/strata/kernels/cpu/iq_avx2.hpp`, `src/kernels/cpu/pool.cpp` | Native IQ expert route, AVX2/AVX-512 capability dispatch, worker-owned scratch, task scheduling and decode row semantics | Keep the current decode path pending same-history NT=1 repeated B570/5600X measurement. No source-level Xe speed estimate can override the user's prior decode claim; that claim itself is not adopted absent pinned receipt. |
| Decode attention/state/cache | `src/core/layer.cpp`, `src/core/session.cpp`, `src/kernels/sycl/decode_attention.cpp`, `native_qsa_indexer.cpp`, `qsa_index.cpp`, `qsa_select.cpp`, `kv_stream.cpp`, `expert_cache.cpp` | Existing native QSA/indexing, cache residency, stream ordering and state/session transitions | An expert-prefill change does not qualify decode attention/cache, RESTORE, context capacity or numerical state. |
| Device transfer, runtime, lifetime | `src/sycl/runtime.cpp`, `src/sycl/device.cpp`, `src/core/expert_source.cpp`, `src/core/expert_cache.cpp`, SYCL kernel launch/copy sites | Queue/event completion, host-source validity, cache publication only after successful copy, bounded fallback and failure handling | B570 async/copy faults and allocation/failure routes need safe bounded qualification. No old faulty binary was executed here. |
| CPU/GPU overlap and scheduler | `src/prefill/prefill.cpp`, `src/kernels/cpu/pool.cpp`, `src/program/generate.cpp` | Host issuer and CPU pool are separate from kernel service; request phase wall is the outcome | R173/R441 diagnostics say host timers/job census do not prove the critical path or per-expert service. Do not infer PCIe or GPU wait from host copy wall/counters. |

`src/prefill/prefill.cpp` contains hard geometry, cache, fallback and buffer assumptions. In particular its own comments warn that fused-buffer sizing only applies if all native pack layers are supported; unsupported Unsloth IQ4_XS Q8_0-down layers must keep full MMQ buffers. Existing stream ring sizing and path selection also depend on pinned share, fused mode, peer path and T. Any candidate must preserve those conditions or explicitly prove a replacement for the exact case.

## Candidate-level decisions

| Candidate | Origin and intended scope | Shape/dependencies and contract | Evidence in reviewed material | Decision / missing proof |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Z current layer-major whole-layer expert upload | Xe-derived Z `include/strata/prefill/layer_major.hpp`, `src/prefill/prefill.cpp`; opt-in `STRATA_PREFILL_LAYER_MAJOR=1` | Fresh standalone/ordinary GEN; fixed supported chunking; private all-expert cache; per-layer source reads; current streamed-KV/QSA/GDN/PLE state flow. Rejects MTP, split/helper, pipeline, vision, borrowed workspace, adaptive swap, SAVE/RESTORE, batch, VRAM commands, and callback/checkpoint states. Needs explicit reserve and actual fresh VRAM/RAM admission. Does not retain the primary's ordinary streamed ring behavior for misses. | R443/R395 describe the old PR#6 route separately: three-pair 32K comparison median 453.2935 vs 645.848 tok/s, all outputs matched, but old source/recipe and other hardware. Not a current primary comparison. The old result is not transferable to Z's rebuilt route. | **Candidate for a new isolated port/adaptation only; not adopted.** Source capability is absent in primary. First reconcile ownership/cache/stream contracts; then test a narrow configuration and fallback. Requires primary-side correctness/state/fault validation and same-binary on/off model-level repeated results. |
| Z default-OFF bulk upload | Z source `src/prefill/prefill.cpp`, `ExpertSource`/Arena layer span; `STRATA_PREFILL_LAYER_BULK_COPY=1` | Only a verified owned Host-USM contiguous 512-expert layer span with exact owner, stride and byte count; prior compute must drain. One synchronous checked copy; source stays valid through source close/destruction. Reserved offsets remain distinct from active offsets. HostUSM0/mmap/shared/split/transient/arbitrary source declines to per-expert fallback. Failed copy must not retry or publish residency; fail-stop. | Z candidate README reports four CPU/ASan/UBSan configurations, real small device tests for 512 experts/seven widths, 1024/32768 fresh GEN, 48 layer copies, 50,292,326,400 logical bytes, 248,320 FP32 logits matching old 4K route at two fixed-history positions. The README explicitly says this is not whole-model/full-256K/RESTORE/speed qualification. Its planned matched quiet three-run remained pending. Source/hash scope is Z, not primary. | **Strongest discrete candidate, still unadopted.** The owned span/lifetime contract is useful and should travel with any adaptation. Current primary `ExpertSource`/cache contracts differ; no source transplant by file or memcpy is safe without re-deriving lease, drain, offset and residency semantics. B570-specific runtime/fault check, full relevant logits/state and matched benchmark absent. |
| W phase4k workspace/head lease + layer-major | Xe-derived W HEAD `9c83ea6…`; source description in Z layer-major design docs | Requires fixed 4096 phase workspace, no resize/rounding/fallback after admission, explicit phase/head lease and workspace/residency transitions. Existing guards cover only the selected serve/fresh-GEN cohort. | W has no measurement evidence cited in the supplied compact report. Z docs state the combined route awaits Main testing and no performance/numerical qualification. | **Do not import as a unit.** Several coupled admission, VMM/cache teardown/remap and request-state contracts are outside primary's current route. First identify a specific reusable contract and prove it against primary source. |
| Z CPU paired IQ3_S GU (`STRATA_IQ256_PAIRED_GU`) | Xe-derived branch, same opt-in pair found by R441 in J and Z | CPU IQ3_S gate/up, row geometry/NT guard, AVX2; affects CPU expert decode/service, not GPU prompt prefill. | R441 says source/fixtures from J are present in Z, and references R436 synthetic results: NT1 −3.76%, NT8 +2.31%; model-level benefit unestablished. | **Keep opt-in/off.** No B570/5600X model-level win; synthetic signs vary with NT. No basis to replace primary current AVX dispatch. |
| Xe kernel family as a whole / 34 TU replacement | Z `src/kernels/xe/*` replacing primary `src/kernels/sycl/*` family | Different runtime/backend/build and kernel implementations across MMVQ, routing, grouped experts, QSA, PLE, KV, GDN/GR and native IQ/MMQ. | R443 identifies a source-family replacement boundary and counterparts, but no matched primary-vs-Z speed result. Similar symbol/function names do not establish math, dispatch, lifetime or performance equivalence. | **Reject as “component adoption”.** Consider only a named kernel with exact target dispatch, proof and primary-vs-candidate comparison. |

### Primary optimizations relative to main that must not disappear

Feature's source tree is substantially divergent from `main`; R443/R444 caution that upstream/main history or a wholesale file replacement does not identify active source. Before any future rebase/port, preserve these active primary-only or primary-specialized routes by their actual caller and settings: `src/prefill/prefill.cpp` chunked expert streaming/ring and cache lending; native IQ/MMQ/fused prompt routing and buffer eligibility; `src/kernels/sycl/native_iq_esimd.cpp` and XMX/ESIMD variants; `src/kernels/cpu/native_expert.cpp` and AVX2/AVX-512 CPU expert selection; primary SYCL native QSA/KV/GDN/GR paths; and the current layer/session/cache lifetime logic. Existing source comments and historical measurements are route-specific and often from NVIDIA; do not restate them as B570 measurements. Exact retained primary measurements must be linked from their compact source-pinned reports before a new implementation round chooses a baseline.

## Safety contracts that a future implementation must preserve

1. **Do not copy layer-major arithmetic/scheduling without fresh source and memory admission.** Candidate Z admits actual cache/workspace/residual/staging/reserve after allocations, checks full-layer residency/slot offsets/capacity, and keeps RAM/GPU prefix stores disjoint. Primary has different cache/ring allocation and borrow/lend lifecycle.
2. **Honor the Host-USM layer-span lease.** Bulk path is valid only for the exact owned source type and verified full layer layout. Prior device compute must complete before active cache pointers/offsets are replaced. Copy is synchronous and checked; source lifetime extends through close/destruction. Declines restore offsets before fallback. A failure cannot publish resident state or continue by retrying per-expert writes.
3. **Keep asynchronous errors and queue drains visible.** A plain completion wait is not, by itself, proof of surfaced asynchronous error. No cache/workspace/source may be freed or republished until the appropriate checked completion/drain contract is satisfied. See R393's chooser audit and project SYCL runtime contracts.
4. **Do not conflate logical capacity with executed positions.** Layer-major reports and short small-device tests do not qualify context 262,144, RESTORE, whole-model math or quality. Fresh GEN, decode continuation, checkpoint and physical full-context are separate cohorts.
5. **Preserve error/cancellation teardown order.** Z's layer-major design fails closed if copy/compute drain is unknown before restoring pointers/callbacks/cache residency. Primary integration must map that to its own queue/session fatal handling; no assumption that failure can roll back a partially executed session.
6. **Keep compute roles separate.** Prefill IQ3_S GU (many rows) and decode GU (NT=1 or MTP/verify rows), Down, routing, activation quantization, cache lookup, transfer, GEMM and attention are independent adoption rows. An optimization that changes grouped row arithmetic can alter greedy output; compare fixed-history logits/state and do not rely on generated text alone.

## Evidence limits and next comparison contract

The user's earlier prefill/decode speed statements are useful hypotheses only; the compact material reviewed here does not identify an exact paired receipt that supports them. R444's performance section records that R278 upstream samples were single-sample, different runtime/client/route and output IDs/LP5 differed; R395 old layer-major repeated result is a different source, hardware/recipe and benchmark from current primary. Z bulk's README does not yet report its planned quiet three-run speed comparison. No numerical or fault result in Z transfers to primary.

For any future adoption decision, hold the same model/hash, input token IDs/history and actual input length, build/runtime/toolchain, context/KV/cache/chunk, CPU affinity/workers, MTP/route, reserve and generated-token count. First verify the primary candidate safely and compare fixed-history logits/state; then alternate at least three clean official-client samples per source/binary arm, reporting each sample and prefill/decode separately. Match the component's actual shape and selected dispatch. Repeat only when the candidate boundary is clear and meaningful; do not execute the known faulty primary revision. A B570 pass requires current source/binary identity, fresh health/fault evidence and safe bounded admission. This audit performed none of those runs.

Reviewed inputs: current project `AGENTS.md`, `.agents/skills/strata-upstream-sync/SKILL.md` and its integration/evaluation references, `docs/ARTIFACT_RETENTION.md`; prior R441–R446 reports (including R443/R444 source/evidence analysis); Z layer-major design and bulk qualification README; primary/Z/W pinned source. Registry v200 was not present in the research directory listing (latest visible file was v113) and was not needed for this bounded source audit.
